title: Guidance for Muslims who Turn To Generative AI for Religious Answers
what_it_is: Guidance for Muslims who Turn To Generative AI for Religious Answers

sections.label: MUIS guidance on AI religious answers
sections.summary: Asked whether MUIS will guide Muslims using generative AI and online sources to verify answers and consult qualified asatizah, which should not be primary sources.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs whether MUIS will issue guidance to help Muslims who use generative AI and other online sources to provide religious answers, to verify such answers against authoritative sources and to know when and where to consult qualified asatizah.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: However, they should not be relied upon as the primary source of religious instruction or guidance, particularly on complex religious matters that require scholarly interpretation and contextual understanding.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: In these situations, a qualified asatizah, or other trustworthy sources of knowledge, should be consulted.

sections.label: Improving access to asatizah
sections.summary: MUIS is looking into improving accessibility to information and asatizah, including upgrading the MuslimSG platform.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: There is certainly room for us to improve accessibility to information, accessibility to asatizah, for example.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: This is one area in which MUIS is looking into, in terms of upgrading the MuslimSG platform.

sections.label: Online committee on emerging risks
sections.summary: The online committee announced yesterday is tasked to look into emerging risks from online sources and online harms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But I assure the Member that this is one area that we are looking at.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And the online committee that I announced yesterday is also tasked to look into some of these emerging risks that come from online sources and online harms.

sections.label: Themes against Singapore's inclusivity
sections.summary: Themes resonating with people may be false or not contextualised to Singapore, such as the Merry Christmas incident, and must be addressed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Overall, what is more important is that we pick out themes, themes that resonate with people and sometimes, these are themes that resonate, but at the same time, may be false or not contextualised to Singapore's context.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: For example, there were incidents a few years ago, where there were concerns of whether you should be able to wish others "Merry Christmas", can you wish someone that?

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, certain themes which goes against the spirit of inclusivity, multi-racialism, our multi-religious context, have to be addressed.

sections.label: Inoculating people against online risks
sections.summary: GenAI comes from algorithms difficult to police, so the risk is like self-styled influencers, requiring inoculating people and helping parents recognise risk.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: GenAI does not come from sites as well; it comes from algorithms that are pulled together from different sites, so it is very difficult to police algorithms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Ultimately, it is also about the same risk as we spoke about yesterday in this House, where you could have a self-styled influencer giving information too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, it is not about guarding where the information comes from, but it is really also about inoculating our people, in terms of how to recognise the risk, helping parents to recognise the risk with what is going on with their kids.
